package billing

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/acme/ledger"
)

const DefaultRate = 3

var counter int

// Engine accrues interest.
type Engine struct {
	rate int
	name string
}

func New(rate int) *Engine {
	return &Engine{rate: rate}
}

// Accrue returns the interest for one period.
func (e *Engine) Accrue(amount int64) int64 {
	if rate := e.rate; rate > 0 {
		return amount * int64(rate)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(e.name))
	fmt.Println(sum, ledger.Name)
	return 0
}
